notes: Self-declared as an Obby with a multi-stage checkpointed course, so Obby & Platformer and its genre-wide P6; the shape answer picks a flat course progressing forward along the ground with modest platform elevation, which is course-flat with no tiered upgrade because that elevation is the ordinary jump-height variation the genre's limits already assume. Classic Obby is the matching preset and I added hazard-kill, which is earned outright here rather than over-applied, since lava kill parts that reset you to the last checkpoint are exactly the contact-lethal surfaces the option describes; winner-zone is inferred because a 10-stage course needs a place for the run to end, and the stated count of 10 stages with one checkpoint each is recorded here as the schema holds no count field. Deciding without a user: the Speed Coil, Jump Coil and Rainbow Fly are Robux products delivered to the backpack through a screen GUI, so they are monetisation and mechanics with no geometry to place — I deliberately did not give the shop a social-hub start zone, because the prompt asks for an on-screen GUI rather than a physical storefront, and inventing one would build a shop the brief argues against. The purchasable fly gear bypasses stages without changing the play space, so it stays grounded-surface rather than volumetric and adds no CHECK.
